project.title: Launch of a Seasonal Healthy Lunch Menu
project.objective: Design, test, and roll out a cost-controlled, healthy seasonal lunch menu that fits existing kitchen capacity and food safety standards.
deliverables: Final seasonal lunch menu with recipes and portions
Standardised recipe cards with preparation steps and timings
Costing sheet per dish with target food cost percentage
Prep and service station layout plan for the new menu
Food safety and allergen reference for all new dishes
constraints: Menu must be fully operational within 21 days
Use only existing kitchen equipment and storage capacity
Respect food safety and hygiene regulations at all times
Keep average food cost per dish within agreed target range
Menu must include vegetarian and low-allergen options

risks.risk: New dishes take longer to prepare than current service window allows.
risks.mitigation: Run timed test services and adjust prep steps, batch cooking, or simplify recipes before launch.

risks.risk: Ingredient costs exceed target food cost percentage.
risks.mitigation: Compare suppliers, adjust portion sizes, and substitute ingredients while keeping taste and quality.

risks.risk: Staff are not fully aligned on new recipes and plating standards.
risks.mitigation: Create clear recipe cards, run training sessions, and do trial services with feedback checklists.

risks.risk: Allergen or dietary information is incomplete or inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: Document ingredients per dish, double-check labels, and have a single reference sheet at the pass.

themes.why_relevant: Cooks must align on variety, nutrition, and feasibility of the seasonal lunch dishes.
Keeping food cost on target requires strict portion sizes and smart ingredient choices.
New dishes must fit existing prep routines and service speed without overloading the team.
All recipes must comply with hygiene rules and have clear allergen information for service staff.

themes.theme: Testing and feedback from trial services
themes.why_relevant: Trial runs help refine recipes, plating, and timing before full rollout.

backlog.task: Draft initial list of seasonal healthy lunch dishes with basic descriptions
definition_of_done: List includes at least 8 candidate dishes with short descriptions
Each dish tagged as meat, fish, vegetarian, or vegan
List shared in channel and agreed as base for recipe work

backlog.task: Develop and document standardised recipes for selected dishes
definition_of_done: Each selected dish has a full recipe with ingredients and steps
Portion sizes and yields are clearly specified
Recipes stored in shared recipe document

backlog.task: Create costing sheet for each new dish using current supplier prices
definition_of_done: All ingredients per dish have unit cost and quantity
Food cost percentage calculated for each dish
Dishes above target flagged with suggestions to adjust

backlog.task: Define prep schedule and batch cooking plan for new menu
definition_of_done: Daily prep list created with timings and responsibilities
Cold and hot prep separated with storage instructions
Plan validated against current staffing and opening hours

backlog.task: Design plating and service guidelines for each dish
definition_of_done: Plating description or sketch for each dish documented
Standard garnish and sauce placement defined
Guidelines reviewed during a short team walkthrough

backlog.task: Compile allergen and dietary information for all new dishes
definition_of_done: All 14 major allergens checked per dish
Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free flags added
Single allergen reference sheet created and shared

backlog.task: Run a small internal tasting and timing session for the new menu
definition_of_done: At least one full run of each dish completed and timed
Taste and timing feedback captured in tasting notes
List of recipe or process adjustments agreed

backlog.task: Adjust recipes and prep steps based on tasting feedback
definition_of_done: Recipe cards updated with any changes
Timing issues addressed via prep or batch changes
Updated versions shared and old versions archived

backlog.task: Prepare cleaning and food safety checklist specific to new menu prep
definition_of_done: Checklist covers critical control points for new dishes
Includes storage, cooling, reheating, and cross-contamination
Checklist printed or made visible in prep area

backlog.task: Coordinate with front-of-house on menu descriptions and service notes
definition_of_done: Plain-language dish descriptions drafted for menu or boards
Key selling points and allergen notes highlighted
Front-of-house feedback captured and final text agreed

backlog.task: Plan launch week service adjustments and backup options
definition_of_done: Launch week service plan drafted with expected volumes
Backup dishes or substitutions defined for key items
Plan shared with whole kitchen team

backlog.task: Set up simple tracking of sales and waste for new menu items
definition_of_done: Daily log format created for portions sold and waste
Team briefed on how to record data
Tracking ready to use from launch day

artifacts.title: Seasonal Lunch Menu Draft
artifacts.used_for: Central document listing candidate dishes, descriptions, and categories for the new menu.

artifacts.title: Standard Recipe Cards Pack
artifacts.used_for: Detailed recipes, portions, and steps for each approved dish, used during prep and service.

artifacts.title: Dish Costing and Food Cost Tracker
artifacts.used_for: Calculates ingredient costs and food cost percentage per dish and tracks adjustments.

artifacts.title: Prep, Cleaning, and Food Safety Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensures all critical prep, cleaning, and safety steps are followed for the new menu.

artifacts.title: Plating and Service Guide
artifacts.used_for: Defines plating standards, garnishes, and service notes for each dish.

artifacts.title: Allergen and Dietary Reference Sheet
artifacts.used_for: Quick reference for allergens and dietary tags for all new dishes.

artifacts.title: Tasting Session Notes and Adjustments Log
artifacts.used_for: Captures feedback from internal tastings and tracks agreed recipe changes.

artifacts.title: Launch Week Sales and Waste Log
artifacts.used_for: Daily record of portions sold and waste to evaluate menu performance.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on candidate dishes and lock the final seasonal lunch menu list.
threads_plan.trigger: Initial post sharing A1 Seasonal Lunch Menu Draft for review and comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which candidate dishes from A1 move forward to full recipe development.
Decide how many vegetarian and vegan options must be on the final menu.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define recipes, portions, and costing for each approved dish.
threads_plan.trigger: Cook shares first version of A2 Standard Recipe Cards Pack and A3 costing sheet.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm standard portion sizes for each dish to hit target food cost.
Approve any ingredient substitutions needed to stay within budget.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up prep workflow, food safety checklist, and allergen reference.
threads_plan.trigger: Post summarising proposed prep schedule and sharing drafts of A4 and A6.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final daily prep schedule and responsibilities for new dishes.
Validate allergen and dietary information for all dishes in A6.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run tasting, refine recipes, and lock plating and service guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: After first internal tasting, cooks share A7 Tasting Notes and draft A5 Plating Guide.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final recipe adjustments based on tasting feedback.
Approve final plating standards and service notes for launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan launch week operations and agree on tracking of sales and waste.
threads_plan.trigger: Cook posts draft launch week plan and shares A8 Sales and Waste Log template.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm launch date and any temporary menu reductions during rollout.
Agree on how and when the team will record sales and waste in A8.

channel_rituals: Daily short async prep check-in each morning to flag issues with ingredients or timing.
Post-tasting debrief thread after each tasting session to capture feedback and next steps.
Launch week end-of-day recap summarising sales, waste, and any incidents from A8.
Weekly planning message reviewing upcoming prep changes or menu tweaks.
